hints: Resolve the two moduli by writing $2(x-1)=3x$ and $2(x-1)=-3x$.
Solve both linear equations, keeping the candidates from both sign cases.
Substitute each candidate into $2|x-1|=3|x|$ as a check.
walkthrough:
Since both sides of the equation $2|x - 1| = 3|x|$ are non-negative, square both sides to eliminate the modulus signs:
$$(2|x - 1|)^2 = (3|x|)^2$$
$$4(x - 1)^2 = 9x^2$$

Collect all terms on one side to form a standard quadratic equation:
$$9x^2 - 4x^2 + 8x - 4 = 0$$
$$5x^2 + 8x - 4 = 0$$

Solve for each linear factor:
$$5x - 2 = 0 \implies 5x = 2 \implies x = \dfrac{2}{5}$$
$$x + 2 = 0 \implies x = -2$$
Alternatively, solve the two linear equations $2(x - 1) = 3x$ giving $x = -2$, and $2(x - 1) = -3x$ giving $5x = 2 \implies x = \dfrac{2}{5}$.

State the two exact solutions:
$$x = -2 \quad \text{or} \quad x = \dfrac{2}{5}$$

ai_rubric.Solving Modulus Equations and Inequaliti: Identifies non-modular equation $(2(x-1))^2=(3x)^2$, or pair of linear equations $2(x-1)=\pm3x$; Gives $x=-2$ and $x=\frac25$; Concludes with $x=-2,\frac25$.

hints: Set $u=5^x$ so that the equation has the same form as part (i), with $u>0$.
Use the two part (i) solutions and discard the one that cannot equal the positive quantity $5^x$.
Solve the remaining exponential equation using logarithms and round $x$ to 3 significant figures.
walkthrough: Notice that the equation $2|5^x - 1| = 3|5^x|$ has the same form as the equation in part (i), with $x$ replaced by $5^x$.

Apply the solutions obtained in part (i) to $5^x$:
$$5^x = -2 \quad \text{or} \quad 5^x = \dfrac{2}{5}$$
Since the exponential function $5^x > 0$ for all real numbers $x$, the equation $5^x = -2$ has no real solution.

Solve the equation $5^x = \dfrac{2}{5}$ by taking natural logarithms of both sides:
$$\ln(5^x) = \ln\left(\dfrac{2}{5}\right)$$
$$x\ln 5 = \ln 2 - \ln 5$$

State the solution correct to 3 significant figures:
$$x = -0.569$$

ai_rubric.Solving Modulus Equations and Inequaliti: Splitting the modulus equation into its signed cases gives $5^x=2/5$; logarithms then give $x=\log_5(2/5)=-0.569$.
